column1: # GIAB reference samples — these carry a NIST "truth" VCF, so they're the
# only samples we can score precision/recall against. They're run through
# the IDENTICAL Snakemake pipeline (extract region -> QC -> align -> BQSR ->
# HaplotypeCaller -> joint genotype -> filter) as the ancestry cohort in
# NOTE: There is no GIAB truth sample for African ancestry. HG001 (NA12878)
# is European (CEU). HG002 is Ashkenazi Jewish (used here as a European-
# adjacent proxy, NOT a substitute for AFR or SAS truth). HG005 is Han
# Chinese (EAS). This gap is itself part of the reference-bias story.
# CRAM source: NIST GIAB FTP, GRCh38-aligned high-coverage CRAMs, e.g.
# Verify exact per-sample paths with scripts/verify_urls.sh before
# downloading — GIAB reorganizes directory layout occasionally.
